restaurant_name: Dental Plus Clinic (คลินิกทันตกรรม เด็นทัล พลัส)
text:
I had my tooth extracted here. The first session was painful because they removed a nerve.
During the 2nd to 4th sessions, I was able to fall asleep.
I was more than impressed! The dentist was lovely. I told them exactly what I wanted done and what I needed. If the dentist recommended something that I didn't want, they were happy to explain the pros and cons and whether or not to proceed with it.

restaurant_name: Dental Plus Clinic (คลินิกทันตกรรม เด็นทัล พลัส)
text:
The clinic isn't very good. They tend to look down on people, assuming they're all poor because they dress casually.
The assistant's language is not good.
The medical registrar is nice, but I won't be going back.

restaurant_name: Dental Plus Clinic (คลินิกทันตกรรม เด็นทัล พลัส)
text: The clinic's management is terrible. I had an appointment at 10:00 AM, but someone who arrived at 10:30 AM was served first, citing an errand. Don't I have errands too? What's the point of having a waiting list if you're going to do this? They didn't even apologize. Terrible management, absolutely awful. They should have more professionalism.

restaurant_name: Dental Plus Clinic (คลินิกทันตกรรม เด็นทัล พลัส)
text: The service was poor and not worth the price. The wisdom tooth extraction cost 4000 baht and didn't include ice. The extraction was painful, and the staff weren't very efficient with supplies.

text:
I've been to many places, but in the end, I always come back here.
The doctor is so kind ♥️♥️♥️
